title: Identity map: II eight eras, II crew and XII/XIV story versions
method: Enumerate only labels and identities already present in this repository. Every row carries a file:line locator and an exact quote. A label is not a person, an ontology ACTOR row is not a real performer, and two enumerations are never merged without a source.

status_definitions.EVIDENCED: A typed identity row exists in this repository (onto_entities or an equivalent registry) and the label plus registry id are both quoted at resolving locators. EVIDENCED does not mean the identity is uncontested, canonised, rights-cleared, or that any source text was recovered.
status_definitions.LABEL_ONLY: The exact label is enumerated in an in-repository document at a resolving locator, but no typed identity row and no present source artifact exist. The missing artifact is recorded on the owning claim or row, not converted into an identity.
status_definitions.NEEDS_SOURCE: The label exists, and a repository document explicitly records its referent, alias, generation, numbering, or source as missing, conflicting, disputed, or requiring typed identity review.
status_definitions.ABSENT: The repository records the artifact or real-person identity as not present at all. The absence is recorded here rather than filled with an invented identity.

kind_definitions.character: A fictional narrative person asserted as such by a repository document and/or a typed CHARACTER registry row.
kind_definitions.crew_label: A surface label from the II crew index whose referent type (character, alias, generation, work) is not resolved by the repository. It is deliberately not promoted to character or actor.
kind_definitions.ensemble: A fictional group, band, or generation. Not a single person.
kind_definitions.entity: A non-person project surface or software entity that shares a label with a story label.
kind_definitions.actor: A real performer/actor identity slot. No real performer is evidenced for the II crew; the one row is an explicit ABSENT record.
kind_definitions.era: A narrative era label reference. Not a calendar period and not a person.
kind_definitions.story_version: A named source version, edition, archive, or patch-registry reference. Not a manuscript claim.
kind_definitions.gap: An explicit unresolved cross-reference that cannot be assigned to one identity without inventing lore.

id_prefix_notes.fg_: Taken from the D04 Figures/Actors prefix in docs/decisions/M02-05-stable-ids-and-legacy-refs.md:21.
id_prefix_notes.other: ch_, cr_, grp_, ent_, er_, sv_ and gap_ are map-local kind prefixes. They identify rows in this evidence map, not canonical D04/D07 primary keys or minted ARSY records. Canonical pointers live in registry_ref.

rows.unresolved: M06-03 enumerates Era 1-8 as Origin & Genesis, Ancient Alliances, Rise of the Towers, The Great Eclipse, Fragmented Realms, The Voice in the Wasteland, Digital Radio & Silent Frequencies, The Witness Horizon (XV). The vision enumerates BEFORE LIGHT, THE ARRIVAL, THE WITNESS, THE RUNAWAYS, THE EXPOSURE, THE CHANGE, END OF AN ERA, NEXT PHASE. No in-repository source aligns the two orders or identifies which set is II's original data/eras.yaml. Both are kept, neither is merged.
rows.notes: This is the gap that keeps all 16 era rows at LABEL_ONLY.

non_claims: No II era order, source version, or data/eras.yaml content is recovered here.
No crew label is promoted to a character, actor, or real person without a typed registry row and locator.
No real performer, voice actor, or casting identity is named for the II crew.
No XII patch title is chosen for disputed slot 014.
No XIV V10 chapter is claimed as a manuscript, original, or per-chapter source version.
No external repository was fetched, cloned, or opened.
No identity here is a canonical D04/D07 primary key or a minted ARSY record.
limitations: Era labels come from two in-repository enumerations that do not align; the underlying II data/eras.yaml was not fetched and is not present.
The M06-01 II pin points at spec/lore/13-functions.yaml, not an eras file, and is a 16-hex ref rather than a full commit.
Crew slot 11 is the only slot with a typed CHARACTER row; the other slots are surface labels or a generation group whose referent type is unresolved.
The ontology kind ACTOR on O008 describes a fictional band; it must not be read as a real performer.
XII and XIV artifacts are external or absent; counts in documents are not opened records.
The absence of real performers is recorded from repository silence plus the rule against identifying real people from fictional labels, not from a casting archive.
